title: CM-CSAMFNet: A cross-modality channel and spatial attention module fusion network for multimodal medical image fusion

model_family.name: CNN
model_family.role: Feature extraction and processing using ghost convolutions and attention modules

contributions.improvement: Superior fusion performance in SPECT-MRI and PET-MRI image fusion tasks
contributions.implementation_detail: Introduces CBAMFNet, a learnable fusion module leveraging cross-modal channel and spatial attention mechanisms.
contributions.improve_from: Conventional fusion approaches with manually designed fusion strategies

contributions.implementation_detail: Employs ghost convolution techniques throughout the network (encoder-decoder blocks).
contributions.improve_from: Multiscale fusion methods suffering from excessive model parameters

contributions.improvement: Comprehensive integration of locally complementary features and global brightness information, accounting for long-range dependencies
contributions.implementation_detail: Proposes a cross-domain attention mechanism named RCBAM.
contributions.improve_from: Existing methods with inadequate consideration of long-range dependencies

contributions.improvement: Enhanced feature extraction and full leverage of multimodal information at each scale
contributions.implementation_detail: Proposes a dual-branch interaction network integrating MRSCAM, residual blocks, and CBAMFNet across multiple scales.
contributions.improve_from: Conventional parallel or shared encoder networks
